investigation_notes.Description: An automated logo scanner detected imagery matching the Vitalis Healthcare brand on the contact page of vitali-pharmacy.it. The page shows a heart/leaf logo with the text 'VITALI Farmacia' which visually resembles the reference Vitalis mark, but the domain and displayed name differ and the site presents as a local Italian pharmacy. The domain is 8 years old and resolves to 104.26.10.225 (Cloudflare) with no additional indicators of compromise in the provided evidence, so this appears to be potential brand misuse or benign local similarity and is considered Low Priority pending brand-owner confirmation.
